strand_baker.text: Strand Bakery. Brown bread, scones and barmbrack, which comes from 'bairín breac', the speckled loaf.
A barmbrack at Halloween has a ring baked in. Whoever finds the ring will be lucky. Whoever swallows it will be quiet.

then.text: Another slice? You have the appetite of a fisherman. Go on.

else.text: Here, a wedge of soda bread for the road. It is best eaten warm, and fastest eaten before the gulls spot it.
